faqs.question: Which exchanges are the safest?
faqs.answer: Coinbase and Kraken are well-regulated in the US. Binance has the largest global liquidity. Look for proof of reserves, compliance, and security track record.

faqs.question: CEX or DEX - which should I use?
faqs.answer: CEX for fiat on/off ramps, advanced trading, and beginner-friendliness. DEX for self-custody, permissionless trading, and access to more tokens. Many use both.

faqs.question: How do I protect my exchange account?
faqs.answer: Enable 2FA (preferably hardware key), use unique passwords, whitelist withdrawal addresses, enable withdrawal delays, and don't store large amounts on exchanges long-term.
